marks.gloss_en: איני? והאמר רבי אבא אמר רב יהודה אמר שמואל: האי תרבא דתותי מתני אסיר -- the fat under the loins is covered by flesh and forbidden
Shmuel: this fat under the loins is forbidden
בהמה בחייה פרוקי מיפרקא -- in life the joints separate, [so it is not fat that the flesh covers] (= p_paroki_mifarka; R' Yochanan recalls the beit midrash saying the same)
an animal in its lifetime separates at the joints
משה! מי אמר רחמנא לא תיכול בישרא? -- the strands are meat; did the Torah forbid meat?
משה! מי אמר רחמנא אכול דמא? -- they are forbidden for the blood; cut and salt it and it is fine even for the pot (= p_rava_mishum_dama, p_rava_chatcheih_umalcheih)
Shmuel: strands in the foreleg are forbidden

איני? והאמר רב המנונא: תנא קרום שעל הטחול אסור ואין חייבין עליו -- if on the dad, why not liable? rather of all of it, [so what is off the dad is forbidden]. Answer: אי תניא תניא (= p_i_tanya_tanya) -- a concession, so no answered_by
Rav Hamnuna's tanna: the membrane on the spleen is forbidden, and one is not liable for it
והתניא: חייבין עליו -- on the spleen's membrane
והתניא: חייבין עליו -- on the kidney's membrane
Rav Hamnuna's tanna: the membrane on the kidney is forbidden, and one is not liable for it
טחול אטחול לא קשיא: הא כנגד הדד, הא שלא כנגד הדד (= p_ok_tchol_kneged_hadad, p_ok_tchol_shelo_kneged_hadad)
this one [liable] is opposite the dad
כוליא אכוליא נמי לא קשיא: הא בעילאה, הא בתתאה (= p_ok_kulya_ilaa, p_ok_kulya_tataa)
this one [liable] is the upper [membrane]
Shmuel: fat that the flesh covers is permitted
Shmuel: fat on the omasum and the reticulum is forbidden, and punished by karet
Shmuel: the top of the intestine, for a cubit, requires scraping
Rav Yehuda: strands in the tail are forbidden
five strands: three on account of fat -- of the spleen, the tail and the kidneys
those on account of blood: if one cuts and salts them, it is fine
five membranes: three on account of fat -- of the spleen, the tail and the kidneys
Rav Yehuda bar Oshaya was cutting it [the spleen's membrane] from the top only
crushed testicles are forbidden (one of Rav Ami and Rav Asi forbids, the other permits)
